scope: Static read-only review of uninvoked inspect/stop/capture helper and imported current/checkpoint/pidfd implementations. No signal, checkpoint read/hash, archive, scheduler write or job launch performed.
passed_static_checks: Readable plaintext Python and visible separate CLI actions. No encoded command, shell loader or transport wrapper.
Stop authenticates reviewed execution release and exact own-source operational review, verifies fixed PID1036598/start571771720/attempt5/module/GPU3/592GiB task and current source refs.

Proc stat verifies start identity, controller PPID, own PGID and SID plus project cwd. A pidfd is opened and identity/task/revision revalidated before SIGTERM. The pidfd targets only that process even if the numeric PID later reuses.

Durable stop intent precedes signal, and existing intent/sent record rejects blind repeat dispatch. The helper does not signal controller or unrelated workers, drain sessions itself or submit queue repairs.

Capture requires controller failed+actual_wait+owned_process_group_absent and no current PID/session; it preserves immutable checkpoint, complete RNG/schedule provenance and all previous output through same-filesystem rename.

Captured model/optimizer validation reuses original full validators, and capture copies checkpoint exclusively with fsync/hash equality. Evidence records all49 optimizer semantics indirectly through validators and original random state keys.

History ordinary-file checks, finite count/byte bound, completed-training exclusion and unchanged output allowance check occur before rename. Required allowance is history plus65MiB, with archive bytes recorded separately.
Permanent predecessor wait receipt is placed in migration work scope, so it survives output archive/restoration. No queue repair is submitted by this helper.

required_repairs.issue: Imported checkpoint() selects the maximum update among every native */checkpoints/latest.pt and does not read latest_checkpoint.json. A stop can occur between latest.pt and latest JSON replacements, creating a valid checkpoint with stale commit metadata. Current capture archives that mismatch before successor live-transition validation rejects it.
required_repairs.required: Before archive, bind selected path to the exact current attempt5 leaf derived from task.call.spec resume_steps and attempt_id. Read that leaf latest_checkpoint.json and require its checkpoint_ref equals selected latest file ref, its complete_parent_updates equals validated saved/captured steps and its digest equals immutable copied checkpoint. On mismatch fail before rename and retain evidence for explicit boundary recovery; do not silently choose an older update or rewrite old metadata.

required_repairs.issue: Capture copies state row into permanent wait and hashes actual_wait.json without checking the file fields match that row.
required_repairs.required: Read and verify actual_wait.json pid/start/attempt/returncode/actual_wait/group absence against current failed row before saving permanent wait. Preserve the source wait hash and its archived location or explicit archive mapping.

required_repairs.issue: Capture validates mutable scheduler/process state only before checkpoint validation/copy and history scan.
required_repairs.required: Immediately before destructive namespace rename, re-read current failed task and require same task/revision/process identity plus actual-wait/absence proof; recheck selected latest metadata/file digests and source wait receipt. Abort before archive if changed. Keep all existing exclusive work files for recovery.

nonblockers_and_limits: No change to pidfd mechanics is required.
Original ordinary-path checks reject checkpoint symlink components before torch.load.
Reviewing source that will validate small checkpoints does not mean this reviewer loaded any checkpoint.
Release, reviewed integration restoration wrapper, fresh immutable capture and scheduler repair remain separate prerequisites; this source review does not authorize invoking stop.
